G1_unambiguity.justification: The mean condition unambiguously requires every interacting pair to receive different levels, and the lexicographic tie-break and output format are explicit.

G2_completeness.justification: It includes all necessary bounds, input details, validity conditions, edge-case handling through the general formulation, and output requirements.

G3_faithfulness.justification: The viscosity formulation is exactly equivalent to assigning opposite values to every conflicting pair while preserving the same bounds, outputs, and lexicographic rule.

G4_naturalness.justification: The industrial-solvent framing is coherent and readable, though it is more elaborate and contrived than necessary for the underlying graph-coloring task.
